answer.rationale: Finance’s 18% cost-cut mandate cannot be met by the incumbent (which has refused to reopen pricing), making renewal non-viable. Memory_c2 shows that a prior switch to a low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit-cost reductions with rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing, indicating feasibility. Memory_c1 confirms that renewing avoids migration risk, but the cost imperative overrides this. With the contract expiring in 14 days and zero production buffer, deferral risks supply continuity. Memories c4 (renegotiation) and c6 (multi-year commitments) confirm no alternative cost-reduction levers are available this cycle, necessitating a decisive switch to meet the mandate.
